contract_note: These are narrow WebOps abilities. PROPOSE is a workflow effect and never invokes a provider mutation.

capabilities.semantic_description: Read stable site identity and platform metadata.
capabilities.security_implications: Verify tenant and redact account data.

capabilities.semantic_description: List bounded content resource summaries.
capabilities.security_implications: Bound pagination and filter private fields.
capabilities.owner: platform adapter; normalized relationships go to ContentGraph

capabilities.semantic_description: Read one bounded content resource and normalized fields.
capabilities.security_implications: Prevent cross-site reads and secret-bearing raw payloads.
capabilities.owner: platform adapter; graph semantics owned by ContentGraph

capabilities.semantic_description: Update an existing bounded content resource without implicit publication.
capabilities.security_implications: Optimistic concurrency, field allowlist, approval, receipt.

capabilities.semantic_description: Publish a previously identified content revision.
capabilities.security_implications: Publication is always explicit ACT; verify environment and tenant.

capabilities.semantic_description: Read platform-native metadata that augments public crawl results.
capabilities.security_implications: Bound fields and do not duplicate public crawl.

capabilities.semantic_description: Update allowlisted metadata fields on one resource.
capabilities.security_implications: Reject arbitrary provider fields and stale versions.

capabilities.semantic_description: List bounded routes from local output or platform metadata.
capabilities.security_implications: Bound filesystem and URL scope.
capabilities.owner: generic/framework profile; SiteProbe owns live discovery

capabilities.semantic_description: Read normalized redirect rules and provider references.
capabilities.security_implications: Redact sensitive paths and bound output.

capabilities.semantic_description: Create or update an explicitly bounded redirect rule.
capabilities.security_implications: Prevent open redirects, loops, broad wildcards, and domain confusion.

capabilities.semantic_description: Read robots policy from public site or generated output.
capabilities.security_implications: SSRF-safe fetch and bounded file access.

capabilities.semantic_description: Apply an approved repository/platform robots policy change.
capabilities.security_implications: Could deindex site; require exact target and review.
capabilities.owner: repository patch or platform adapter via Dispatch

capabilities.semantic_description: Read sitemap references and bounded URL inventory.
capabilities.security_implications: SSRF-safe fetch and size limits.

capabilities.semantic_description: Submit an existing sitemap URL to a configured search provider.
capabilities.security_implications: Verify search property ownership and exact URL.

capabilities.semantic_description: Inspect public or deployment response headers.
capabilities.security_implications: SSRF controls and secret header redaction.
capabilities.owner: SiteProbe; adapter may supply preview URL

capabilities.semantic_description: Apply an approved repository/platform header configuration change.
capabilities.security_implications: Security policy and caching blast radius; validate rule grammar.
capabilities.owner: repository patch or narrow platform adapter

capabilities.semantic_description: List bounded asset summaries.
capabilities.security_implications: Bound payload and omit signed URLs.

capabilities.semantic_description: Inspect metadata for one asset without downloading unbounded content.
capabilities.security_implications: Size/type bounds; SSRF-safe retrieval.

capabilities.semantic_description: Read deployment project, environment, and domain identity.
capabilities.security_implications: Cross-project guard and domain verification.

capabilities.semantic_description: Read bounded deployment status and immutable references.
capabilities.security_implications: Verify project binding and redact logs/environment.

capabilities.semantic_description: Trigger a deployment from an explicit source revision or hook.
capabilities.security_implications: Wrong-project/cost amplification; require bounded source and environment.

capabilities.semantic_description: Promote a verified deployment to an explicit environment.
capabilities.security_implications: Production boundary; require prior Eval/Lens evidence and approval.

capabilities.semantic_description: Restore a provider-supported prior deployment reference.
capabilities.security_implications: Rollback is not universal; validate provider support and target.

capabilities.semantic_description: Resolve a verified preview URL for a deployment/content revision.
capabilities.security_implications: Do not log preview credentials; verify host allowlist.

capabilities.semantic_description: Purge an explicit, bounded list of URLs.
capabilities.security_implications: Rate/cost/blast radius; forbid purge-everything fallback.

capabilities.semantic_description: Read provider-native edge measurements with dimensions and provenance.
capabilities.security_implications: Query-cost bounds and property verification.
capabilities.owner: SearchBridge normalization; edge adapter may supply identity

capabilities.semantic_description: Read normalized site analytics measurements.
capabilities.security_implications: Least privilege, query bounds, privacy-safe dimensions.

capabilities.semantic_description: Read normalized search performance measurements.
capabilities.security_implications: Property verification and row/query bounds.

capabilities.semantic_description: Read normalized field/lab performance measurements.
capabilities.security_implications: URL scope and cost bounds.

capabilities.semantic_description: Register an allowlisted event subscription to an explicit receiver.
capabilities.security_implications: Webhook trust, SSRF, secret storage, replay protection.

capabilities.semantic_description: Verify and normalize an incoming provider event.
capabilities.security_implications: Signature verification, replay protection, size bounds, no implicit ACT.
